verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout as a sensible vertical stack with a large bottle and a centred CTA. Its flaws: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow now sits below the body copy, which breaks the reading order; the body copy wraps to leave an orphaned 'sparkling.'; and the headline runs half onto the peach circle. B jams every element into the top ~55% and leaves the bottom ~45% as dead space. Its circle sits directly on the bottle cap, so the bottle reads like a balloon-headed figure, and '20% off' butts against the circle. The eyebrow is jammed near the top edge and the left copy column is cramped.
